actionSemantics.PROMOTE: Candidate may become a new canonical ToolBox module after its named gate.
actionSemantics.ADAPT: Reuse an existing owner/source through a consumer seam; do not create a competing owner.
actionSemantics.KEEP_INTAKE: Retain as donor/evidence/source candidate; no canonical or public-runtime claim.
actionSemantics.REJECT_DUPLICATE: Do not promote as a competing source. Retain forensic/history files in place.
